title: Longest Zero-Sum Subarray
statement:
Find the longest subarray (a block of consecutive elements) whose sum is exactly `0`, and report its length. If no subarray adds up to `0`, report `0`.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers.

## Output
Print the length of the longest subarray with sum `0`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9`
